design_principles: Prefer a small compositional vocabulary over many brittle mutually-exclusive pose classes.
A broad pose may be caption-valid when it is the simplest ordinary explanation of the visible crop and nothing visible contradicts it.
Missing anatomy outside the crop is not counterevidence.
SAM3D reconstruction may support a broad pose family but reconstructed invisible anatomy must not be serialized as observation.
Before adding a new base pose, ask whether an existing pose is a crop-adequate proxy.

base_pose_families.description: Upright weight-bearing pose; may remain a crop-adequate proxy when lower legs/feet are hidden.
Body configuration that reads naturally as sitting, including cropped seated portraits where the chair or feet are not visible.
Body supported in a leaned-back or partially horizontal rest pose without requiring fully supine/prone geometry.
Clearly horizontal or bed/floor-supported body configuration.
Lowered compact weight-bearing pose with strong leg flexion when visible or strongly implied by the crop.
Knee-supported pose when the distinction is visually represented and useful.
Standing-like locomotor pose with a visible step/stride or one leg advancing.
Primarily characterized by a strong torso lean/bend when standing/seated support is secondary or unclear.
No useful broad pose family can be selected from the visible crop.

crop_relevance.extreme_close_up: Broad posture usually irrelevant; prioritize face/head/hands/accessories.
crop_relevance.close_up: Broad posture optional; head-body and visible hand/support configurations dominate.
crop_relevance.medium_close_up: Broad posture useful when reasonably supported; torso and arm relations matter strongly.
crop_relevance.three_quarter: Broad posture and leg configuration increasingly important.
crop_relevance.full_length: Broad posture is normally essential and standing/seated/kneeling distinctions should be visibly discriminated.
